learningObjectives: Differentiate classification, regression, and clustering problems
Understand the basic purpose of common ML algorithms
Select an appropriate algorithm based on a problem type

activities.title: ML Problem Map
activities.instruction: Explore the map to connect real-world problems with ML task types.

content.concept: Classification predicts categories, regression predicts numerical values, and clustering discovers groups in unlabeled data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Predicts a discrete category such as spam or not spam.
Predicts a continuous numerical value such as house price.
Groups similar data points without predefined labels.

activities.title: Algorithm Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each ML problem with a suitable algorithm.

content.concept: Algorithms such as linear regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors, and k-means address different learning tasks.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Decision Tree Builder
activities.instruction: Build a simple decision tree using the available decision nodes.

content.concept: A decision tree repeatedly splits data using feature-based conditions to reach predictions.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Prediction Playground
activities.instruction: Adjust the feature value and observe the predicted output.

content.concept: A trained model learns patterns from examples and uses those patterns to produce predictions on new inputs.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Choose the Algorithm
activities.instruction: Select an appropriate algorithm for each machine learning scenario.

content.concept: Algorithm selection depends on the target type, available data, problem structure, and modeling requirements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
